data_description.api_url: Full URL of the plate recognition endpoint.

abort.missing_credentials: Add Nakordoni application credentials first (client ID/secret from the DevAPI portal).

init.title: Plate recognition options

data.loose_plates: Plates in notify-only mode (comma separated, optional)
data.strict_reads: Strict mode: matching reads in a row

init.description: Pick the cameras to scan. On the next pages you choose, per camera, when it is scanned. Each scan uses one API call.

data_description.cooldown: Minimum time between two scans of one camera. The same plate on the same camera inside this time fires no new event.
data_description.watched_mode: Strict: only the top reading counts, the plate must match exactly, and N reads in a row inside the window must match. Use strict for gates. Loose: any reading or candidate counts (notify only, not for gates).
data_description.loose_plates: These watched plates use loose mode. All other watched plates use the mode above.
data_description.strict_reads: The watched-plate sensor turns on (and a gate opens) only after this number of matching reads in a row.
data_description.configure_gates: Add, keep or remove gates. A gate opens only on a strict match.

camera.title: Auto-scan
camera.description:
Camera: {camera}

Each scan uses one API call. Scans only run while the camera is available.

data_description.motion_entity: Binary sensor (motion, occupancy or presence). A scan runs when it changes from off to on.
data_description.fast_mode: Sends config mode=fast to the API (about 0.1-0.2 s faster). On by default for cameras that feed a gate.

gates.title: Gate opening
gates.description: A gate opens only on a strict match. Keep a manual or remote way to open the gate. Never make this the only access method for emergency services.

data.keep_gates: Keep these gates (clear one to remove it)

gate.title: Gate
gate.description: The gate entity is a cover (open), switch (turn on), button (press) or lock (unlock).

data_description.start: Leave start and end empty to allow at any time. A start later than the end means a window over midnight.
data_description.cooldown: After an opening, this gate does not open again inside this time.

error.motion_required: Pick a motion sensor for "On motion".
error.gate_entity_domain: Pick a cover, switch, button or lock.

recognize.name: Recognize plates
recognize.description: Run plate recognition on cameras, an image URL or a local file. Give exactly one.

image_url.name: Image URL
image_url.description: Public image URL (private/LAN URLs are refused by the API).

options.loose: Loose: notify only, not for gates
